agreement.title: Terms of Service Agreement for Cryptocurrency Exchange
agreement.section1_1: This agreement (hereinafter — the Agreement) regulates the procedure for providing exchange service (hereinafter — the Service) for exchanging cryptocurrencies and other digital assets between the user (hereinafter — the User) and the Service.
agreement.section1_2: Using the Service means full and unconditional acceptance of the terms of this Agreement by the User.
agreement.section1_3: The Service reserves the right to make changes to the Agreement without prior notice. The current version is published on the Service website.
agreement.section1_4: Services are provided only to adults who have the right to work with digital assets according to the legislation of their jurisdiction.
agreement.section2_1: Application processing is carried out within 10 minutes from the moment of receiving cryptocurrency from the User.
agreement.section2_2: Payment is made exclusively in cryptocurrency to the User's wallet address.
agreement.section2_3: The User must provide accurate data and correct cryptocurrency addresses. The Service is not responsible for incorrectly specified addresses.
agreement.section2_4: To confirm an incoming transaction, the Service may request additional materials: transaction hash, sending screenshot, video recording or other information. Application processing may be suspended until confirmations are received.
agreement.section2_5: The Service does not control blockchain networks and is not responsible for confirmation delays, network congestion, increased fees or technical failures.

agreement.section3_1_item2: Confirm cryptocurrency sending upon Service request.
agreement.section3_1_item3: Use the Service within the legislation of your country.
agreement.section3_2_item1: Correctly perform the exchange according to the User's request.
agreement.section3_2_item2: Inform about the application status and delays.
agreement.section3_3_item1: Suspend application processing until confirmations are provided.
agreement.section3_3_item2: Refuse service if rules or legislation are suspected to be violated.
agreement.section3_3_item3: Change operating conditions by posting current information on the website.

agreement.section4_2: The User is fully responsible for the correctness of provided addresses.
agreement.section4_3: The Service does not return cryptocurrency sent to an incorrect address due to User's fault.
agreement.section4_4: In case of force majeure, the Service may temporarily suspend operations.
agreement.section5_1: The Service does not transfer personal information to third parties, except in cases provided by law.
agreement.section5_2: The User agrees to data processing for exchange execution and security.
agreement.section6_1: The Agreement comes into force from the moment of acceptance by the User.
agreement.section6_2: Disputes are resolved through negotiations, and if impossible — in accordance with the legislation of the Service jurisdiction.
